newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Some Russian sectors reviving - Chernomyrdin.
newsitem.headline: Some Russian sectors reviving - Chernomyrdin.

text.p: Some Russian industrial sectors are showing signs of recovery, but the economy as a whole is stagnant, Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin said on Wednesday.
Chernomyrdin told the State Duma lower house of parliament that gross domestic product in the first four months of this year was unchanged from a year earlier.
But there were some hopeful developments. Inflation was slowing this year and the volume of retail sales picking up.
Production levels in machine-building, light industry and chemicals were up, and there was also output growth in Russia's key raw materials sectors of oil and non-ferrous metals.

Ministers now concede the economy will not grow significantly until 1998. Until recently the government had been forecasting growth of up to two percent this year after several years of economic decline.
